subject: Maths
topic: Data Handling — Bar Graphs and Probability

questions.q: In the Exemplar wage table for 30 workers, the class 830-840 has frequency 9, while 10 workers earn Rs 850 or more. What is the difference between these two counts?
questions.explanation: The frequency table shows 9 workers in the 830-840 class. Adding the frequencies from 850-860 through 890-900 gives 1 + 3 + 1 + 1 + 4 = 10 workers earning Rs 850 or more. The difference is therefore 10 - 9 = 1.

questions.q: A favourite-food survey has 120 people: 40 prefer South Indian food and 25 prefer Chinese food. What is the difference between their pie-chart sector angles?
questions.explanation: South Indian food represents 40/120 of the circle, giving 120 degrees. Chinese food represents 25/120 of the circle, giving 75 degrees. The difference is 120 - 75 = 45 degrees.

questions.q: A coin is tossed 200 times and heads appears 120 times. What is the experimental ratio of heads to tails?
questions.explanation: There are 200 - 120 = 80 tails. The ratio of heads to tails is therefore 120:80. Dividing both terms by 40 simplifies the ratio to 3:2.

questions.q: A jar contains 6 red, 5 green, 4 blue and 5 yellow marbles of the same size. If one marble is chosen at random, what is the probability that it is not red?
questions.explanation: The jar contains 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 = 20 marbles. Non-red marbles total 5 + 4 + 5 = 14. Therefore the probability of not choosing red is 14/20 = 7/10.
